$Comment: The Yeti Fur Coat, one of the two pieces of his fur the Yeti's Boss Kill Claim can pay (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Yeti_Chase.json, 1 in 10 on the first win each day). A full item body with no Parent, so it inherits no recipe and nobody crafts it: it wears the game's own heavy leather chestpiece (Armor_Leather_Heavy_Chest's model, texture and icon) with the heavy leather chestpiece's armour, and more on top: 20% less Ice damage, the cold the Yeti's own snowballs hit with, and more Health. It belongs to no gear set. Raise or lower an Amount to tune it.
